title: Metabolism Light Kit Neo4j Seed
description: Fill Neo4j metabolism graph from assets/fixtures/metabolism.kit.light.compose.json (wip.initialKit only, no VCS/history). Node labels: domain entities (Design, Piece, Blueprint, Type, Connector, Port, Connection, Side). Relationships only HAS, IS, REFERENCES. Support MATCH pattern Piece-HAS-Blueprint-IS-Type-HAS-Connector-IS-Port and Connection sides REFERENCES Connector under Design.
summary: Added `seed.metabolism.light.kit.neo4j.ts` to load `wip.initialKit` from `assets/fixtures/metabolism.kit.light.compose.json` into the Bolt database `metabolism` (default), wiping existing nodes first. Graph uses labels Design, Piece, Blueprint, Type, Connector, Port, Connection, Side and only relationships HAS, IS, REFERENCES: kit types and ports, Type-HAS-Connector-IS-Port, Design-HAS-Piece/Connection, Piece-HAS-Blueprint-IS-Type, Connection-HAS Side edges with `{parent:true|false}`, Side-REFERENCES-Connector. Wired `bun ./script.ts seed neo4j metabolism-light-kit`, Nx target `workspace:seed-neo4j-metabolism-light-kit`, and npm script `seed:neo4j-metabolism-light-kit`. Verified on live DB: pattern match count 4662 for Nakagin design; `CALL db.relationshipTypes()` returns only the three allowed kinds.
